method: Started from 5,284 priced Kalshi legs in the next 36 hours. Kept legs priced 30–85¢ with edge of about −2.5 or better and no flags, one per game, and matched them by hand against today's 341 collected expert picks (the dump again returned no automatic matches) and Polymarket top-trader positions. A leg stayed only if at least two of top-trader money, a published pick or model, and concrete matchup/injury news agreed, with nothing disagreeing. Dropped for conflicts: Wizards +6.5 (Sports Mole, Covers, Deadspin and Predictem on Washington with $1.7k top-trader money, but Dimers' model on Orlando), Houston −4.5 vs Baylor (Covers, RotoWire, RotoBaller on Houston but SI picks Baylor outright), Colorado −3.5 (College Football News projects only a 3-point Colorado win), Patriots −1.5 (five outlets on New England but top traders slightly the other way), Virginia Tech ML and Oklahoma State −5.5 (top traders on them, RotoBaller against), Giants ML (Yahoo and SBD against), Rockets ML (BettingPros and Dimers against), Ohio State −7.5 vs Michigan (outlets split), Washington ML at Arizona (SBD and VSiN against) and Alabama ML (priced at the 85¢ ceiling, RotoBaller on Auburn). Saturday games fill most of the ladder; Sunday's two NFL totals sit at legs 8–9 so longer ladders still fill in after today's games start.
honest: Every leg costs slightly more than its fair price (edge about −0.2 to −2.5¢ each), so expected return is slightly negative, and it gets worse with each leg you add.

ladder.game: Kansas State Wildcats @ Iowa State Cyclones
ladder.label: Iowa State Cyclones −3.5
ladder.why: RotoWire's Chris Bennett and RotoBaller's Mike Marteny both take Iowa State −3.5, citing a Kansas State team that is winless on the road and without its starting QB, and College Football News' Pete Fiutak predicts Iowa State 30-24. Polymarket top traders hold $1.0k on Iowa State against $0.4k the other way.

sources.name: College Football News via Yahoo / Pete Fiutak (Iowa State 30-24)

ladder.label: Northern Illinois Huskies −3.5
ladder.why: Covers' Brad Powers takes NIU −3.5, calling the Huskies much better than their record while UTEP, under an interim coach, just lost by 49 to Air Force. Top traders have $2.5k on NIU and nothing against.
